## Jet Ducting

8

## Research Path

[Helicopters](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Helicopters_Research), [Planes](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Planes_Research), [Jets](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Jets_Research)

Jet ducting is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| Category | Component |
| --- | --- |
| Jet Engines | Jet Duct Angle |
| Jet Engines | Jet Duct Cross |
| Jet Engines | Jet Duct Diagonal |
| Jet Engines | Jet Duct Straight |
